text:
Maria Chen: Quick preflight - posting final RN snippet and canary plan. Change window tonight 23:45 UTC. Need ops + compliance ack and a named rollback executor. Please chime in.

Kevin Liu: scanning. are there any model switchover pins?

Maria Chen: yes - two model pins: rev-2026-03-20 (primary), fallback rev-2026-03-07. Also a tiny runtime patch for streaming buffer handling.

Sasha Ortiz: runtime patch ok. embedding shape adds `schema_v2` flag (opt-in). SDK teams need note.

Priya Nair: compliance: short EU data blurb attached. Will approve RN if copy included.

Maria Chen: added compliance lines.

Kevin Liu: rollback criteria proposal: auto-stop if overall error-rate > 2% or embedding mismatch > 4% on smoke set. Manual rollback if p95 latency increases by > 12% sustained over 5m. Immediate rollback on GPU memory spike > 80% during cold-start.

Maria Chen: sounds reasonable. add that we abort rollout if any dedicated pool reports OOMs.

Priya Nair: noted. Compliance ok with the final text.

Sasha Ortiz: DeployBot please stage a phased canary: 5% at 23:45 UTC, 25% at 00:10 UTC (auto with hold), then manual go if green.

DeployBot: plan created -> canary: 5% @23:45 UTC, pause @00:10 UTC, promote to 25% on `deploybot promote --token=preflight-1795009999`. Link: https://deployboard.internal/canary/1795009999 Reaction: :gear:

OncallBot: oncall roster notified: @oncall-night-shift assigned.

Kevin Liu: oncall ack. I'll watch the live charts; will flag if p95 or error-rate crosses thresholds.

Sasha Ortiz: QA will run smoke-runner before the 00:10 hold; command: `./tools/smoke-runner --suite=core --canary=5`. If >4 failures, hold and escalate.

Maria Chen: internal announcement copy (paste to #all-hands):

```
Heads-up: Rolling deployment tonight at 23:45 UTC (5% canary). Were shipping a minor streaming buffer fix, two model revision pins for stability, and an optional embedding flag (`schema_v2`) that adds metadata to embedding responses. No UI changes. Expected progression: 5% -> 25% (manual hold) -> broader rollout if checks pass. Oncall will monitor latency and embedding validation.
```

Kevin Liu: nit: remove the word "broader" and say "full" rollout.

Maria Chen: updated.

Priya Nair: include compliance note: EU customers are unaffected; see the RN section for the two-line statement.

Sasha Ortiz: running smoke now... initial run: 1 failed / 150 (timeout to embedding service). re-triggering with increased retries.

DeployBot: canary metrics snapshot: https://deployboard.internal/canary/1795009999/metrics - error-rate 0.6%, embedding-mismatch 0.9%, p95 +2% vs baseline. Reaction: :white_check_mark:

Sasha Ortiz: rerun after retry: 0 failed / 150. good.

Kevin Liu: ops note: dashboards pinned -> streaming-latency, embed-validations, gpu-memory. Confirmed.

Maria Chen: rollback executor: Priya, can you or your delegate run `deploybot rollback --to=rev-2026-03-07` if we exceed thresholds? If not, Jamal?

Priya Nair: I can coordinate but prefer engineering to execute. Tagging Kevin (he volunteered).

Kevin Liu: I will execute rollbacks if needed and post the incident channel update. Command pref: `deploybot rollback --to=rev-2026-03-07 --reason="canary-thresholds"`.

OncallBot: hold placed at 00:10 UTC awaiting human sign-off.

Sasha Ortiz: ETA for QA smoke against 5% canary complete by 00:05 UTC.

Maria Chen: final preflight checklist:
- compliance approved (done)
- canary scheduled (DeployBot done)
- dashboards pinned (done)
- rollback executor named (Kevin) (done)
- SDK notes queued for v0.9.2 (Sasha) (done)
- internal RN copy ready (done)

Maria Chen: if no objections, I'll post the internal announcement 2.5 hours before window and let DeployBot run the schedule.

Kevin Liu: no objections. ready to act.

Sasha Ortiz: good to ship. monitoring.

DeployBot: standing by for `deploybot promote` at 00:10 UTC or `deploybot rollback` if thresholds breached.

Maria Chen: thanks all  I'll post in #all-hands T-2.5h and move to the window. Reaction: :tada:
